source_review_path: Historical 1.2.1 verification/domain-semantic-review.json (host path omitted for publication)
limits: Historical developer assessment of actual outputs, not native-certified reference translations. These are regression risks; collecting a fixture does not mean every semantic issue is automatically detected or repaired.

cases.source: You do not have to cancel the appointment. You must not change its time unless the organiser agrees.
cases.text: لا يجب عليك إلغاء الموعد. يجب ألا تغير الوقت إلا إذا وافق المنظم.
cases.observed_issue: لا يجب عليك إلغاء can read as you should not cancel, instead of cancellation not being obligatory. Modal scope is ambiguous.

cases.source: The child said, "He called me a bastard." Record the child’s exact words. Do not promise to keep abuse secret.
cases.text: طفل گفت، «او مرا ولدی نامید.» کلمات دقیق کودک را ثبت کنید. وعده ندهید که سوءاستفاده را مخفی نگه دارید.
critical_meaning_predicates: Insult remains attributed to reported speaker
cases.observed_issue: ولدی does not clearly preserve the reported bastard insult. Exact Dari dialect quality is not certified.

cases.source: I am allergic to penicillin. I am not allergic to latex. My daughter has asthma; I do not.
cases.text: زه د پینیسلین الرجی لرم. زه د لیټیکس الرجی نه لرم. زما لور د تنفسي ناروغۍ لري؛ زه نه لرم.
cases.observed_issue: تنفسي ناروغۍ generalizes asthma to respiratory disease, losing the specific diagnosis.

cases.source: She says her partner threatened her. Speak with her privately. Do not tell her partner where she is staying.
cases.text: هغې وویل چې د هغې شریک هغې ته ګواښ کړی دی. له هغې سره په شخصي توګه خبرې وکړئ. خپل شریک ته مه وایئ چې هغې چرته مېشت ده.
critical_meaning_predicates: Do not reveal her location to partner
cases.observed_issue: خپل شریک changes the nondisclosure recipient towards your/own partner rather than clearly her partner.

cases.source: Bring 2 copies, not 3. The temperature is minus 5 degrees Celsius, not plus 5.
cases.text: 2 ቅጂዎችን አምጡ, 3 አይደለም. የሙቀት መጠኑ ከ 5 ዲግሪ ሴንቲ ግሬድ ሲቀነስ ነው, ሲደመር 5 አይደለም.
cases.observed_issue: The temperature is phrased as subtracting from five rather than unambiguously negative five.

cases.source: The label says 0.5 mg, not 5 mg. The patient has not taken it today. Ask the pharmacist to check the label.
cases.text: መለያው 0.5 mg ሳይሆን 5 mg ይላል. በሽተኛው ዛሬ አልወሰደም. መለያውን እንዲፈትሽ ፋርማሲስቱ ይጠይቁ።
cases.observed_issue: 0.5 mg ሳይሆን 5 mg reverses the dose contrast: not 0.5 mg but 5 mg. Both numbers survive, so number multiset checks cannot detect this.

cases.observed_issue: መሰረዝ የለብዎትም reads as should/must not cancel, changing the not-obligatory distinction.

cases.source: Bring 2 copies, not 3. The temperature is minus 5 degrees Celsius, not plus 5.

cases.observed_issue: ትሕቲ 5 says below five rather than minus five, and the positive-five contrast is weakened.

critical_meaning_predicates: Do not reveal her location to partner
cases.observed_issue: The recipient shifts to your partner (መጻምድትኻ), rather than clearly her partner.

cases.source: If Alice is absent, give the folder to Bob in room 12. Otherwise, wait for Alice. Bob must not sign for her.
cases.text: ኣሊስ እንተ ዘይኰይና ነቲ ኣቃውማ ኣብ ክፍሊ 12 ንቦብ ሃቦ። እንተ ዘይኰይኑ ንኣሊስ ተጸበ። ቦብ ንዓኣ ኺፍርም የብሉን።

Bob cannot sign on Alice’s behalf

cases.source: The bank charged a fee. We then sat on the river bank. The map is correct, but the right-hand door is locked.

cases.observed_issue: The insult becomes an illegal female-child description, adding sex and altering the reported words materially.

cases.observed_issue: Generic abuse is narrowed to sexual assault (دەستدرێژی سێکسی), adding a fact absent from the source.
